subject.title: feat(repair): add digest-bound Gitcrawl evidence intake

question: Should Gitcrawl repair intake permanently require `gitcrawl-evidence-job-v1`, quarantine legacy jobs, and support local, cloud, and strict parity providers under the new fail-closed contract?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but it intentionally removes the old accepted-job behavior and establishes an external provider support contract; tests cannot authorize that compatibility and operations commitment.

options.title: Approve the strict contract
options.body: Accept evidence-required jobs, legacy quarantine, and all three provider modes after operational sign-off.

options.title: Phase in strict enforcement
options.body: Preserve a temporary legacy compatibility mode while operators migrate to evidence-bound jobs.

options.title: Land local mode first
options.body: Merge immutable local evidence binding and defer cloud and parity support to a separately approved change.

recommendation.title: Approve the strict contract
recommendation.body: Accept evidence-required jobs, legacy quarantine, and all three provider modes after operational sign-off.

likelyOwner.reason: Merged history shows this person introduced the current Gitcrawl repair intake and owns the proposed replacement architecture.
